verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a compliance toolkit for consent capture/management, PII masking/blocking before data reaches destinations, an Event Audit API for governance, and self-hosted/open-source deployment giving control over data location (including EU/US residency), all supporting a privacy posture. However there is no explicit documentation of configurable data retention periods, a delete/erasure API, or automated data purging, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: explicit retention-period configuration, a documented delete/erasure API or workflow, evidence of automated data purging.
